summary: Iteration 3 (Ghaziabad Times rebrand + Page 1-4 newspaper nav + hide-admin-link + secure /control-login) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 25/28 passed. Frontend Playwright: public home, admin redirect, login (wrong+correct), token storage, logout all PASS. TWO real bugs found: (1) watermark global settings doc still says 'MyNews' so newly fetched article images get wrong watermark; (2) brute-force lockout is bypassable because request.client.host alternates between proxy pod IPs behind ingress.

critical.issue: GET /api/settings returns watermark_text='MyNews'. Startup rebrand migration only runs on articles collection, not on settings doc. As a result, new fetched/manual-upload articles bake 'MyNews' into images instead of 'Ghaziabad Times'. Confirmed via test_fetch_news_with_token_demo: freshly fetched article has watermark_text='MyNews'. Fix: in startup migration also run db.settings.update_one({'_id':'global','watermark_text':'MyNews'}, {'$set': {'watermark_text': SITE_NAME}}).

Brute-force lockout keyed by (request.client.host, email) but behind the k8s ingress the TCP peer alternates between proxy pod IPs (observed 10.201.4.155 and 10.201.4.156 interleaving). After 7+ wrong attempts the API still returns 401 instead of 429, so an attacker can bypass the 5-attempt lockout by letting the LB round-robin. Fix: key the counter by email only, or trust X-Forwarded-For.

action_items: Patch startup migration to rebrand settings.watermark_text from 'MyNews' to 'Ghaziabad Times' (also safe to always set to SITE_NAME on cold start if value equals the old default).
Fix brute-force lockout key: either drop IP from identifier (ident = email) or respect X-Forwarded-For header, otherwise 5-attempt protection is defeated in production.

rca of the issue: Watermark bug RCA: get_watermark_text() reads from settings.global doc; that doc was set to 'MyNews' in previous iterations and never rebranded on startup — only db.articles.update_many(..., 'MyNews' -> SITE_NAME) runs. Repro: GET /api/settings -> {'watermark_text':'MyNews'}; POST /api/fetch-news -> returned article.watermark_text='MyNews'. Lockout bug RCA: backend logs show POSTs alternating between source IPs 10.201.4.155 and 10.201.4.156 for the same client, confirming request.client.host does not identify the real client; the ident '(ip,email)' therefore partitions the counter across pods. Mitigation: migrate settings.global on startup AND key lockout by email (or X-Forwarded-For first hop).
